title: Grateful Dead Live at Yasgur's Farm on 1969-08-16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of Woodstock’s chaotic 1969 set – historic Dark Star and a monster 45‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight, but plagued by technical mishaps.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard feed that, despite the infamous microphone feedback, power cuts and stage wobble, delivers surprisingly clear audio with a strong audience presence. Musically the show is a mixed bag: Dark Star shines and Pigpen’s extended Lovelight is a highlight, yet the performance is uneven – St. Stephen aborts early and the band sounds distracted by on‑stage chaos.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews range from 1 to 5 stars; several praise the historic performance and sound quality, while others condemn the chaotic playing, yielding an overall average around 3‑ish.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear details; audience bleed adds atmosphere. Noted mic feedback, power outages and occasional muddiness but generally listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Historic Woodstock set with typical Dead improvisation; performance hampered by technical distractions, resulting in a uneven flow.

band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s Lovelight praised as a 45‑minute highlight, though another reviewer calls his sound terrible and mentions a mic incident that injured him.
